description: Cached results of a real H2 (4-qubit, STO-3G) VQE energy evaluation on IonQ Forte Enterprise via Amazon Braket. Loaded by the notebook so Cells > Run All completes without resubmitting billable QPU tasks. Each energy was independently recomputed from the completed Amazon Braket S3 task data (see verify_result.py / verify_mitigated.py).
notes: The variational principle guarantees the hardware energy is an upper bound on FCI, so the error is positive. Debiasing improved the result by about 1 mHa, which indicates the residual error is dominated by incoherent two-qubit-gate noise and decoherence rather than coherent bias. Reaching chemical accuracy (1.6 mHa) on this circuit needs the fuller mitigation stack (readout mitigation, symmetry post-selection, zero-noise extrapolation).
